description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the Time API's Project Report Data endpoint in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes setup routines for test data, and a test method to verify retrieval of project report data. It specifically tests the API endpoint 'getAll' using various test cases.

classes.name: ProjectReportDataAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Project Report Data API endpoint related to time reporting in OrangeHRM. It sets up test data and validates the 'getAll' method of the TimeReportDataAPI class.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data before any tests run, loading fixture YAML files for permission and project report data tests.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Unit test method for verifying the 'getAll' functionality of the TimeReportDataAPI using provided test parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case parameters for the 'testGetAll' method from a YAML-based data source.
